name: Authorize.Net API
tagline: Payment gateway API for card authorization, capture, and recurring billing
description: Authorize.Net is a Visa payment gateway whose primary API is a single endpoint (xml/v1/request.api) that accepts JSON or XML for card/eCheck authorization, capture, refund, and customer payment profiles. Developers also use Accept.js for client-side tokenization and the Transaction Reporting API for settled batches and statements. Auth is API Login ID plus Transaction Key in the request body; production (api.authorize.net) and sandbox (apitest.authorize.net) are available.

auth.details: API Login ID and Transaction Key sent in the merchantAuthentication object of each JSON/XML request body (not a header). Obtain credentials from the Merchant Interface or sandbox account.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Sandbox free for development; production has monthly gateway fees and per-transaction fees (varies by processor/reseller — check current pricing)
pricing.paid_plans: Gateway and per-transaction fees; pricing depends on reseller and payment processor

use_cases: create a customer payment profile for recurring billing
list settled batch transactions for reporting
validate merchant API credentials in sandbox
